research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: SnSe orthorhombic Pnma 8-atom cell
purpose: Thermoelectric sidecar reference (PRD §L1.5) — record-ZT (~2.6 along b-axis) high-T thermoelectric.
notes: Low-T alpha phase (Pnma, #62). Lattice a = 11.498 Å, b = 4.151 Å, c = 4.445 Å. 4 Sn + 4 Se = 8 atoms in primitive cell. The high-T beta (Cmcm) phase that delivers record ZT is a separate fixture for downstream waves if needed.
